title: Form Prefill
content: Build form prefill functionality. URL params: read field values from query string. Storage: prefill from localStorage or API. Mapping: map param names to field names. Transform: transform values as needed. Defaults: merge with default values. Clear: option to clear prefilled data. Privacy: handle sensitive prefilled data carefully.

variants.simple: Prefill form fields from URL parameters or stored data.
variants.detailed: Build form prefill functionality. URL params: read field values from query string. Storage: prefill from localStorage or API. Mapping: map param names to field names. Transform: transform values as needed. Defaults: merge with default values. Clear: option to clear prefilled data. Privacy: handle sensitive prefilled data carefully.
variants.advanced: Build comprehensive form prefill system from multiple sources. URL parameters: parse URLSearchParams, map to form fields, support nested params (address[city]=NYC). LocalStorage/SessionStorage: read saved draft data, merge with defaults. API response: prefill from existing record (edit mode), transform API format to form format. Data sources priority: defaults < storage < URL params < API (or configurable order). Field name mapping: handle different param names vs form field names, transformation rules. Value transformation: convert strings to proper types (numbers, booleans, dates), handle arrays from comma-separated, decode URI components. Partial prefill: fill only provided fields, keep defaults for others. Sensitive data: never prefill passwords, tokens, or security questions from URL, consider hiding from browser history. Clear prefill: button to reset to defaults, clear storage. Edit mode detection: detect if editing existing record vs creating new, show appropriate UI. Prefill indicators: optionally show which fields were prefilled, "Reset to original" per field. Validation timing: validate prefilled data, show errors if invalid. History cleanup: optionally remove prefill params from URL after reading (replaceState). Multi-step forms: prefill data persists across steps. Testing: query string builder for testing prefill scenarios. Redirect handling: preserve prefill params through auth redirects. Accessibility: announce when form is prefilled. Analytics: track prefill usage and sources. Default value handling: distinguish between empty and intentionally cleared.
